_doc: Measured rent samples, one file per city: data/rent-samples/<slug>.json. A trial started 2026-11-26 (docs/research/2026-11-26-rent-sampling-trial.md). These files do NOT feed the build; shipped rent still comes from data/cost-evidence/<slug>.json. scripts/summarize_rent_samples.py computes every `usd` and `summary` from the listings, and `--check` (part of npm run check) fails if a stored value differs or a listing lacks a snapshot whose excerpt contains its quote.
city: Exact city name as in travel-data.json.
collectedOn: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the listings were seen.
storedRentUsd: data/cost-evidence/<slug>.json components.rent.usd at collection time, copied for comparison only.

searchDefinition._doc: Written before collecting and identical across cities (id furnished-1br-midterm-v1). Per-city parts are the neighbourhoods and portal filters actually used.
searchDefinition.unit: whole furnished unit (no shared rooms, no hotel rooms), studio or 1 bedroom
searchDefinition.stay: available for a 1-3 month stay starting within ~2 months
neighbourhoods: 2-4 named areas where slow travellers stay, chosen before looking at prices

markets.longTermLocal: local long-term rental portal: what a resident pays (asking price, usually 12-month lease or open-ended)
markets.midTermFurnished: platforms a traveller would book for 1-3 months (Flatio, Spotahome, Uniplaces, HousingAnywhere, local serviced-apartment portals): the monthly price for a ~1-2 month stay

searchDefinition.order: listings taken in the order the portal shows them under the stated neutral sort; none skipped except by the exclusion rules

<CUR>.source: open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD (the feed the cost-evidence store cites)

portals.sort: the neutral sort used, e.g. portal default / newest

listings.id: short stable id, e.g. portal listing id
listings.url: listing URL (or results page URL if listings have no stable URL)
listings.priceBasis: per month as shown | per month for a stated stay length
listings.includes: what the shown price includes: utilities / internet / service fee / deposit not included ... or 'not stated'
listings.quote: verbatim card/listing text (>= 25 letters) holding the price
listings.exclude: OPTIONAL manual reason: duplicate of <id> | wrong type | outside size band ...

longTermLocal | midTermFurnished.summary: computed: listingsSeen, n, medianUsd, p25Usd, p75Usd, minUsd, maxUsd, storedRentUsd, diffVsStoredPct, exclusions[] (manual first, then outliers beyond 1.5xIQR fences, computed once)

portalsTried.outcome: used | blocked | terms forbid automated access | robots.txt disallows | too few results
